sites.name: Indonesia corporate headquarters
sites.place: South Quarter Tower C, Jakarta Selatan

source.label: Grab Holdings Limited Annual Report on Form 20-F for fiscal 2024 (company-hosted), Item 4.D Property, Plants and Equipment
source.quote: We are dual-headquartered in Singapore and Indonesia. … our corporate headquarters in Indonesia is located at South Quarter Tower C, Mezzanine and 7th Floor, Jl. R.A. Kartini Kav. 8, Cilandak Barat, Cilandak, Jakarta Selatan

notes: Grab operates in eight Southeast Asian countries (Cambodia, Indonesia, Malaysia, Myanmar, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam), with local offices in each market outside Singapore. The FY2025 20-F gives employees only by function (12,012 full-time at Dec 31, 2025, including 865 at Everrise, a supermarket chain) and no partner earnings by country. Revenue by country exists in the 20-F but is already in the records. The only non-revenue country figures are loan receivables (credit exposure): Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore and Thailand as country rows, and 'Other countries' ($97M) as a region with no country list. The Philippines and Vietnam, listed separately in the FY2024 table, are now inside 'Other countries', so their rows were removed. Leased offices total over 110,546 sq m at Dec 31, 2025. The FY2025 20-F names only the Singapore principal executive offices; the Jakarta headquarters row is kept from the FY2024 20-F (company-hosted PDF, still online on 2026-11-24), which described Grab as dual-headquartered in Singapore and Indonesia.
